text.text: I use mixed-methods data to understand user behavior and turn insights into better products, experiences, and growth strategies.

My background in public health shapes how I approach problems: looking beyond individual pain points to understand the behavioral and systemic factors driving what people do. I pair that lens with a hands-on approach to building, using AI tools to analyze data, prototype ideas, and test solutions quickly.
I'm especially interested in consumer health products that help people better understand their health and turn that knowledge into action.
Survey analysis · Statistical analysis · Regression · ANOVA · T-tests
Interviews · Concept testing · Usability testing · Thematic analysis
Claude · GPT · Perplexity for research synthesis, pattern identification, and rapid analysis, paired with human judgment to interpret subgroup and population-level findings in context.
SPSS · Excel · Qualtrics · Salesforce · Coda · Claude Code · Tableau · ArcGIS · Dedoose
I'm a quick learner, enjoy learning new software, and learn best by getting hands-on and building with it.
